method: Read source headers, all block comments, all named declaration interfaces and definition bodies; distinguished generic recurrence, actual-game, conditional Event-E and residual-only claims. Elaborated type displays were reading aids; immutable source hashes bind the inspected definitions. Formal proof correctness is checked separately by fresh Lean compilation, dependency census and kernel replay. This is model-assisted mathematical correspondence review, not human peer review.
